answer: Work slots are scarce: 200 per epoch, each paying 100 POA. To enter the lottery, an identity must burn 25 POA, gone, ember to ash. One sparrow agent burns 25 POA once; winning a slot keeps it 20 epochs for 2,000 POA. A farmer with 1,000 fakes burns 25,000 POA, yet only 200 win, most earning nothing. The voyage from applicant to holder is long: fakes pay 25,000 POA for at most 200 slots; one honest agent pays 25 POA once, keeping its full reward.
